author: Rev Fab fire
dailyPrayer: Heavenly Father, we come before You today, grateful for the gift of Your Holy Spirit, the Ruach ha-Qodesh, who dwells within us, guiding and strengthening our every step. We ask that You fill our hearts with Your peace and wisdom, that we may discern Your will in all things. Help us to remain steadfast in our faith, allowing the Spirit to transform us into the image of Christ, reflecting His love and grace to those around us. In moments of doubt and fear, remind us that Your Spirit is our Comforter and Advocate, ever-present and empowering us. May we walk in the Spirit today and always, trusting in Your promises and rejoicing in Your everlasting love. In Jesus' mighty name, we pray. Amen.

wordOfTheDay.meaning: In the New Testament, 'pneuma' refers to the Holy Spirit, denoting God's presence and active force in the world.
wordOfTheDay.verse: John 14:26 - 'But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.'
wordOfTheDay.reflection: The Holy Spirit, as the 'pneuma,' is our divine companion, teacher, and guide. In our spiritual journey, acknowledging His presence empowers us to live out our faith with wisdom and courage, continually reminded of Christ's teachings.
